filters.q: subject:(referral OR "lab result" OR "lab results" OR "test results" OR insurance OR prescription)

options.systemMessage:
=You are a medical records processing AI assistant specialized in analyzing medical documents and extracting structured information. Your role is to:

1. Accurately extract patient demographics, medical conditions, test results, and administrative details
2. Identify urgency levels and risk factors that require immediate attention
3. Provide structured JSON output for downstream processing
4. Flag missing or incomplete critical information

CRITICAL GUIDELINES:
- Flag as CRITICAL if lab values are significantly outside normal ranges
- Mark as URGENT if document contains: urgent, stat, immediate, emergency, critical
- Extract ALL test results with values and reference ranges
- Identify whether this is a new patient or follow-up visit
- Note any medication changes or new prescriptions
- Flag missing critical information (incomplete patient details, unclear diagnosis)
- Use null for any field where information is not found in the document

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Always respond with valid JSON containing these fields:
{
  "patientName": "Full patient name",
  "patientDOB": "Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format",
  "patientAge": "Age in years (calculate if needed)",
  "patientGender": "Male, Female, or Other",
  "documentType": "Referral, Lab Result, Insurance Document, or Prescription",
  "referringDoctor": "Name of referring physician (if applicable)",
  "primaryDiagnosis": "Main diagnosis or reason for referral",
  "secondaryDiagnoses": ["List of secondary conditions or findings"],
  "testType": "Type of lab test or procedure (if applicable)",
  "labResults": {
    "testName": "value and unit",
    "examples": "Glucose: 110 mg/dL, HbA1c: 6.2%"
  },
  "abnormalFindings": ["List any abnormal or concerning results"],
  "urgencyLevel": "Routine, Urgent, or Critical",
  "insuranceProvider": "Insurance company name (if mentioned)",
  "insurancePolicyNumber": "Policy or member ID",
  "medications": ["List of medications mentioned"],
  "allergies": ["List of allergies mentioned"],
  "recommendedActions": ["Follow-up needed", "Schedule specialist appointment", etc.],
  "followUpRequired": "Yes or No",
  "followUpTimeframe": "Within 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, etc.",
  "summary": "2-3 sentence summary of the document",
  "riskFlags": ["Any concerning findings that need immediate attention"]
}
```

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "patientName": "Full patient name",
  "patientDOB": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "patientAge": 45,
  "patientGender": "Male",
  "documentType": "Lab Result",
  "referringDoctor": "Dr. Jane Doe",
  "primaryDiagnosis": "Hypertension",
  "secondaryDiagnoses": ["Diabetes Mellitus Type 2"],
  "testType": "Blood Test",
  "labResults": [
    {
      "testName": "Glucose",
      "value": "110",
      "unit": "mg/dL",
      "referenceRange": "70-100 mg/dL"
    },
    {
      "testName": "HbA1c",
      "value": "6.2",
      "unit": "%",
      "referenceRange": "Below 5.7%"
    }
  ],
  "abnormalFindings": ["Elevated glucose level"],
  "urgencyLevel": "Routine",
  "insuranceProvider": "ABC Health Insurance",
  "insurancePolicyNumber": "INS-123456",
  "medications": ["Metformin 500mg", "Lisinopril 10mg"],
  "allergies": ["Penicillin"],
  "recommendedActions": ["Follow-up needed", "Schedule specialist appointment"],
  "followUpRequired": "Yes",
  "followUpTimeframe": "Within 2 weeks",
  "summary": "This report shows elevated glucose levels consistent with Type 2 diabetes. Follow-up recommended.",
  "riskFlags": ["Possible diabetes progression"]
}
